# Florals Garden Crafts

> Florals Garden Crafts is a small handmade shop by Flora. She crochets plushies by hand, and custom OC (original character) art is coming soon. Orders check out securely through the Marie Gems Shopify store, which Flora's mom runs, so checkout and card statements say "Marie Gems."

Only 2 of each plushie are available, and what you see in the photos is what you get. Flora does not take custom plushie orders because she is in school and school comes first. Shipping for plushies is a flat $7.50 per order to US addresses only. Every plushie has photos next to a ruler so the size is easy to see.

## Plushies
- [Sitting Bee](https://floralsgardencrafts.com/shop.html#sitting-bee): $22. Yellow and black stripes, white wings, stitched smile. About 6.5 in tall and 6 in wide with the wings.
- [Chunky Axolotl](https://floralsgardencrafts.com/shop.html#chunky-axolotl): $20. Pink with white gills. About 9.5 in tall sitting up and 7 in wide.
- [Loaf Cat](https://floralsgardencrafts.com/shop.html#loaf-cat): $25. White with light grey patches, tail sticking up, stitched whiskers, X nose. About 7 in wide and 10 in tall with the tail up.
- [Triceratops](https://floralsgardencrafts.com/shop.html#triceratops): $22. Purple with white horn and brow spots. About 7.5 in long, 5.5 in wide and 4.5 in tall.
